interpretation.summary: A driving, dark EBM/coldwave track at 120 BPM in A minor, characterized by a relentless 16th-note synth bass arpeggio, a four-on-the-floor beat with a heavily reverberated snare, and detached female vocals. The production style evokes classic 80s industrial and post-punk with its analog-style synths and prominent rhythmic elements.

vocabulary.timbre: Timbre is dominated by synthetic, analog-style sounds including a saturated sawtooth bass, sharp metallic hi-hats, and a bright, bell-like FM lead synth.
vocabulary.brightness: The track has a wide spectral range, with a deep, dark bass foundation contrasted by crisp, bright hi-hats and cutting lead synth transients.
vocabulary.envelope: Envelopes are predominantly tight and percussive, featuring short attack and decay times on the bass and drums to emphasize the aggressive, rhythmic drive.
vocabulary.register_density: The arrangement focuses on the low and high registers, with a powerful bassline anchoring the bottom and hi-hats/lead synth occupying the top, leaving the mid-range relatively open for vocals.
vocabulary.harmony_mode: The harmony is stark and rooted in A minor, relying on simple root-octave bass motion and sparse melodic lines, reinforcing a bleak, industrial atmosphere.
vocabulary.groove: A relentless four-on-the-floor EBM groove is established by the kick drum, a strong backbeat snare, and continuous 16th-note hi-hats, creating a highly danceable yet rigid feel.
vocabulary.space_grit: Space is defined by a large, classic gated reverb on the snare, while grit comes from noticeable saturation and drive on the main bass synth.

tracks.name: Kick
tracks.pattern: A driving four-on-the-floor pattern on every quarter note.
tracks.description: The foundational pulse of the track, a punchy and consistent kick drum that drives the rhythm from the start.

tracks.name: Gated Snare
tracks.pattern: A strong backbeat on counts 2 and 4.
tracks.description: A bright, snappy white noise snare with a very large and prominent reverb, defining the track's 80s-inspired spatial character. Present throughout.

tracks.name: Hi-Hats
tracks.description: Bright, metallic hi-hats provide high-frequency energy and reinforce the driving 16th-note subdivision of the groove.

tracks.name: Arp Bass
tracks.pattern: A continuous 16th-note arpeggio, outlining the root, fifth, and octave.
tracks.description: The primary melodic and rhythmic engine of the song. Its saturated, punchy tone and constant motion create the track's signature tension and drive. It's present almost throughout.

tracks.name: Pluck Lead
tracks.pattern: A sparse, high-register melodic phrase with a distinct rhythmic character.
tracks.description: This lead synth enters around 0:22, playing a simple, memorable hook that cuts through the dense rhythm section. It has a bell-like, metallic quality and is processed with a noticeable delay.

tracks.name: Vocal Pad Proxy
tracks.pattern: Sustained single notes following the main vocal contour.
tracks.description: This track serves as a synthetic proxy for the detached female vocals. It holds long notes in the mid-range to represent the harmonic space occupied by the voice, particularly in the verses.

tracks.name: Chorus Drone
tracks.pattern: A single, long sustained root note held for multiple bars.
tracks.description: Enters during the chorus sections (e.g., 0:40) to add weight and harmonic depth. This fat, detuned saw pad sits underneath the main arp bass, creating a powerful wall of sound.
